review.summary: The proposal does not address the issues of endpoint validation and diagnostics, nor does it specify how cloud failures should be exposed to operators. Additionally, there is no clear metric gate for evaluating success criteria, making it challenging to determine whether the proposed change will improve reliability.
top_technical_reasons: Improper proposal title: The title suggests a recovery method but does not address endpoint validation or cloud failure exposure.
Insufficient details on how changes would be made: The technical implementation files and metric gate are not specified, leaving open the possibility of significant changes without clear direction.
candidate_safety: No safety measures are mentioned in the proposal. There is no information about how the proposed changes will affect local fallback or production state.
The decision to change production weights (which could include trade decisions) was not specified, and there were no details on what metrics would be used as gate criteria for success.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Implement endpoint validation with deterministic diagnostics without changing the current setup.
next_experiments.change: Add endpoint validation checks in cloud_sync.py and tests/test_storage.py to ensure that endpoints are validated before CloudSync is initiated, while maintaining the current configuration of local SQLite fallback.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Endpoint failures should be clearly marked as errors when initiating CloudSync; local storage remains operational without any mutations to production state.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This hypothesis addresses endpoint validation and provides a clear metric gate for success. By ensuring that the endpoints fail early, it can help isolate the issue and inform future improvements.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Expose cloud failures in an unobtrusive way without altering production state.
next_experiments.change: Introduce CloudSync initialization checks around Supabase credentials configuration to ensure that any errors or invalid endpoints are captured and logged securely, rather than failing the production system.
next_experiments.metric_gate: CloudSync initialization should fail gracefully if there are endpoint failures; local storage remains operational without changes to the current setup.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This hypothesis addresses how cloud failure could be exposed while preserving safety. It also provides a clear metric gate for assessing success.

review.verdict: The change to add deterministic endpoint validation, sanitized diagnostics, and tests around CloudSync initialization without impacting the core production workflow enhances overall security post-Supabase updates. Specifically, enhanced diagnostic coverage minimizes error propagation upon failures, while ensuring local persistence simplifies recovery. It provides a necessary layer of confidence within the system when it is unavailable.

review.summary: The proposal aims to enhance Supabase connectivity reliability while ensuring local fallback mechanisms remain intact. The current behavior indicates that the system is configured but facing DNS resolution issues, which necessitates improvements in endpoint validation and diagnostics.
top_technical_reasons: The current configuration has failed DNS resolution, indicating a need for better endpoint validation.
Local SQLite fallback is operational, ensuring that local writes can continue even when Supabase is unavailable.
The proposal includes adding deterministic endpoint validation and sanitized diagnostics, which are crucial for identifying issues without exposing sensitive information.
review.candidate_safety: All production safety flags remain false, ensuring that no changes will affect the production state or expose secrets.
